Census figures of Spanish municipalities, 1842-2011

Source: R/data.R
censos.Rd

Population census data for every municipality and census edition, from `Municipis_Espanya_1842-2011.xlsx`. A municipality is in force at a census when `hogares` is not missing. Rows with `no_munic == 1` are the non-municipal territories (codes 53xxx) present in the maps, which have no census figures.

Usage

censos

Format

A data frame with columns:

cod_ine

INE municipality code (5 characters; 6 for municipalities extinct before 1900).

censo

Census year.

municipio

Municipality name.

prov

Province.

cod_ccaa, ccaa

Autonomous community code and name.

PJ

Judicial district (partido judicial).

hogares

Households.

pder

De jure population.

phec

De facto population.

pob_serie

Continuous population series.

no_munic

1 for non-municipal territories (53xxx), 0 otherwise.
